---
title: "Sunrise vs Sunset Times over the Year"
format: html
engine: knitr
filters:
  - webr
webr:
  packages:
    - suncalc
    - ggplot2
    - dplyr
    - svglite
---

For every day of the chosen year this page computes the sunrise and sunset
times at a given location with the R package
[suncalc](https://cran.r-project.org/package=suncalc) and plots each day as a
point (*x* = sunrise hour, *y* = sunset hour). The red points mark the day with
the earliest sunset and the day with the latest sunrise. All computation
happens locally in your browser: R itself runs as
[WebAssembly](https://docs.r-wasm.org/), loaded by the
[quarto-webr](https://github.com/coatless/quarto-webr) extension.

Enter a location and a year, then press **Plot**. Hover the mouse over a
point to see that day's date.

#| context: setup
#| message: false

<style type="text/css">

<script type="module">
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const logEl = $("ss-log"), plotEl = $("ss-plot"), btn = $("ss-go");

// Size of the plot, in points (1/72 inch). 720pt is like `fig-width: 10`
// in Quarto. The plot is rendered as SVG and displayed at 1 viewBox unit
// = 1 css pixel, so it stays crisp at any zoom level. Make this number
// bigger or smaller to resize the plot.
const PLOT_PTS = 720;

// Default the year input to the current year
$("ss-year").value = new Date().getFullYear();

function logLine(text, cls = "") {
  const span = document.createElement("span");
  span.textContent = text + "\n";
  if (cls) span.className = cls;
  logEl.appendChild(span);
  while (logEl.childNodes.length > 500) logEl.removeChild(logEl.firstChild);
  logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
}

// Run R code with warnings/messages re-routed to stderr and errors
// re-thrown (so that they surface as JavaScript exceptions)
function withLogging(body) {
  return `tryCatch(
  withCallingHandlers({
${body}
  },
    warning = function(w) { cat("Warning: ", conditionMessage(w), "\\n", sep = "", file = stderr()); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
    message  = function(m) { cat("Note: ",    conditionMessage(m), "\\n", sep = "", file = stderr()); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") }
  ),
  error = function(e) stop(conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
)`;
}

const plotBody = (lat, lon, year, tz) => `
lat  = ${lat}
lon  = ${lon}
year = ${year}
tz   = "${tz}"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library("suncalc")
  library("ggplot2")
  library("dplyr")
})

# Dates for the chosen year
dates = seq(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-01-01", year)), as.Date(sprintf("%04d-12-31", year)), by = "day")

# Sunrise and sunset times
suntimes = suncalc::getSunlightTimes(date = dates, lat = lat, lon = lon, tz = tz)

# Extract hour of day as decimal (e.g., 6.5 = 6:30 AM)
hour = function(x) as.numeric(format(x, "%H")) + as.numeric(format(x, "%M")) / 60 + as.numeric(format(x, "%S")) / 3600

periodicdiff = function(x) {
  x[c(2:length(x), 1)] - x
}

suntimes = dplyr::mutate(suntimes,
    sunrise = hour(sunrise),
    sunset  = hour(sunset),
    speed   = periodicdiff(sunset-sunrise) * 60
)

specialdays = bind_rows(
  dplyr::slice_min(suntimes, sunrise)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_max(suntimes, sunset)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_min(suntimes, sunset)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_max(suntimes, sunrise)[1,]
) |> bind_cols(
  what = c("EarliestDay", "Latest Night", "EarliestNight", "LatestDay"),
  hjust = c(  0,    0,   1,    1), 
  vjust = c(1.5, -0.5, 1.5, -0.5)
) |> unique()

p = ggplot(suntimes, aes(x = sunrise, y = sunset, col = speed)) +
  geom_path(col = "#707070") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(name = "change (min/day)") +
  xlab("Sunrise (hour)") + 
  ylab("Sunset (hour)") +
  ggtitle(sprintf("Sunrise vs sunset times at (%.2f, %.2f) in %d", lat, lon, year)) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 18, base_family = "Helvetica Neue") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_point(data = specialdays, col = "red")  +
  geom_text(data = specialdays, col = "black", size = 8,
            mapping = aes(hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, label = format(date, "%d %b")))

# --- mouse-over support: the plot is rendered as SVG (svglite), so that
# in the web page every point is a real <circle> element that the page
# can attach a date to. svglite's width/height are in inches: 720 pt = 10 in.
s = svglite::svgstring(width = ${PLOT_PTS} / 72, height = ${PLOT_PTS} / 72, pointsize = 12)
print(p)
invisible(dev.off())
svg = s()  # fetch only after dev.off(): the SVG is complete (valid XML) then

# webR's svglite cannot see the fonts of the system it runs on (every
# family falls back to "Noto Sans"), so write the requested font stack
# back into the SVG: the web browser displaying it resolves the font.
svg = gsub('font-family: "[^"]*"',
           'font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif',
           svg)

# The circles appear in the SVG in draw order: first the daily points,
# then the four red "special day" points. ggplot2 silently skips rows
# with missing coordinates, so collect the dates of exactly the circles
# that were drawn, in the same order.
daily_ok   = !is.na(suntimes$sunrise) & !is.na(suntimes$sunset)
special_ok = !is.na(specialdays$sunrise) & !is.na(specialdays$sunset)
circle_dates = c(format(suntimes$date[daily_ok], "%Y-%m-%d"),
                 format(specialdays$date[special_ok], "%Y-%m-%d"))

.GlobalEnv$.svg   = svg
.GlobalEnv$.dates = paste(circle_dates, collapse = ",")`;

function showCapturedOutput(output) {
  for (const o of output) {
    if (typeof o.data === "string") {
      const cls = o.data.startsWith("Warning") ? "warn" : o.data.startsWith("Note") ? "note" : "";
      logLine(o.data, cls);
    } else {
      logLine(`[${o.type}]`);
    }
  }
}

function showSvg(svgText, datesText) {
  hideTip();
  plotEl.replaceChildren();
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(svgText, "image/svg+xml");
  if (doc.querySelector("parsererror")) {
    logLine("ERROR: could not parse the SVG plot", "err");
    return;
  }
  const svg = document.importNode(doc.documentElement, true);
  svg.setAttribute("width", PLOT_PTS);   // 1 viewBox unit == 1 css pixel
  svg.setAttribute("height", PLOT_PTS);
  plotEl.appendChild(svg);
  attachTooltips(svg, datesText);
  svg.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
  svg.addEventListener("pointerleave", hideTip);
  window.__svgVersion++; // used by automated tests
}

// ---- mouse-over tooltip ----------------------------------------------
// The plot is injected as an SVG, so every point is a <circle> element.
// The R code above also exports the date of each drawn circle, in draw
// order; write it onto the circles as a data-date attribute and show it
// in a small tooltip when the mouse moves near a point.

const tipEl = document.createElement("div");
tipEl.id = "ss-tip";
tipEl.hidden = true;
document.body.appendChild(tipEl);

let tipPoints = [];     // [{x, y, date}] in viewBox (device point) units
const HOVER_PT = 10;    // hover distance around a point, in viewBox units

function hideTip() { tipEl.hidden = true; }

function showTip(x, y, text) {
  tipEl.textContent = text;
  tipEl.hidden = false;
  tipEl.style.left = x + "px";
  tipEl.style.top = y + "px";
}

function attachTooltips(svg, datesText) {
  const circles = Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll("circle"));
  const dates = datesText ? datesText.split(",") : [];
  circles.forEach((c) => c.removeAttribute("data-date"));
  if (dates.length !== circles.length) {
    logLine(`Note: date tooltips unavailable (${circles.length} points but ${dates.length} dates)`, "note");
    tipPoints = [];
    return;
  }
  circles.forEach((c, i) => c.setAttribute("data-date", dates[i]));
  tipPoints = circles.map((c) => ({
    x: Number(c.getAttribute("cx")),
    y: Number(c.getAttribute("cy")),
    date: c.getAttribute("data-date"),
  }));
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
  if (!tipPoints.length) return hideTip();
  const svg = e.currentTarget, rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
  const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
  const scale = rect.width / (vb.width || PLOT_PTS);  // css px per viewBox unit
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / scale;
  const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) / scale;
  let best = null, bestD2 = HOVER_PT * HOVER_PT;
  for (const p of tipPoints) {
    const d2 = (p.x - x) ** 2 + (p.y - y) ** 2;
    if (d2 <= bestD2) { best = p; bestD2 = d2; }
  }
  if (best) showTip(e.clientX, e.clientY, best.date);
  else hideTip();
}

let shelter;
window.__runs = 0;       // small counter used by automated tests
window.__svgVersion = 0; // bumped every time a new SVG plot is displayed

function setBusy(busy, label) {
  btn.disabled = busy;
  if (label) btn.textContent = label;
}

async function runPlot() {
  const lat = Number($("ss-lat").value);
  const lon = Number($("ss-lon").value);
  const year = Number($("ss-year").value);
  const tz = $("ss-tz").value.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_+/-]/g, "");

  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)  return logLine("ERROR: latitude must be between -90 and 90", "err");
  if (!Number.isFinite(lon) || lon < -180 || lon > 180) return logLine("ERROR: longitude must be between -180 and 180", "err");
  if (!Number.isInteger(year) || year < 1 || year > 9999) return logLine("ERROR: year must be an integer between 1 and 9999", "err");
  if (!tz) return logLine("ERROR: please provide a timezone (e.g., UTC)", "err");

  const code = withLogging(plotBody(lat, lon, year, tz));
  $("ss-rcode").textContent = code;

  window.__runs++;
  logLine(`— Plotting for lat = ${lat}, lon = ${lon}, year = ${year}, tz = ${tz}`);
  setBusy(true, "Plotting…");
  try {
    const cap = await shelter.captureR(code, { captureGraphics: false });
    showCapturedOutput(cap.output);
    // The R code leaves the SVG plot and the dates of its circles in the
    // R global environment; fetch both before purging the shelter.
    const svgText = await globalThis.mainWebR.evalRString('if (is.null(.GlobalEnv$.svg)) "" else .GlobalEnv$.svg');
    const datesText = await globalThis.mainWebR.evalRString('if (is.null(.GlobalEnv$.dates)) "" else .GlobalEnv$.dates');
    if (typeof svgText !== "string" || !svgText.includes("<svg")) {
      logLine("ERROR: no plot was produced (see messages above)", "err");
    } else {
      showSvg(svgText, datesText);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logLine("ERROR: " + (err?.message ?? String(err)), "err");
  } finally {
    await shelter.purge();
    setBusy(false, "Plot");
  }
}

(async () => {
  logLine("Loading the R WebAssembly runtime and packages (suncalc, ggplot2, dplyr, svglite)…");
  try {
    if (typeof globalThis.qwebrInstance === "undefined") {
      throw new Error("the quarto-webr extension did not initialize — is the `webr` filter enabled and the `_extensions/webr/` directory present?");
    }
    await globalThis.qwebrInstance; // webR is booted, packages installed and loaded
    shelter = globalThis.mainWebRCodeShelter;
  } catch (err) {
    logLine("ERROR: could not start webR — check your internet connection. " + (err?.message ?? String(err)), "err");
    return;
  }
  logLine("R " + await globalThis.mainWebR.evalRString("paste0(R.version$major, '.', R.version$minor)") + " is running in your browser.");
  setBusy(false, "Plot");
  btn.addEventListener("click", runPlot);
  logLine("Ready.");
  await runPlot(); // draw the default plot right away
})();
</script>
